content.text:
From the repository root, run:

```bash
python scripts/build_docs.py
python -m sphinx -W --keep-going -b html -c docs build/docs/source build/docs/html
```

Then open `build/docs/html/index.html`.

If dependencies aren’t installed yet, first run:

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade numpy setuptools wheel
python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e '.[docs,test]'
```

See the [documentation build instructions](/home/maxwell-rosen/postgkyl/docs/source/contributing.rst:19) for validation and headless rendering setup.
